name: map-scale
useFor: Put it in the map's bottom-left corner. `label` is the true distance the bar covers at the map's center ("640 ft"); a new zoom level changes the label, never the bar. On imagery make it Bone with `text-fg-inverse`.
constraints: A label that does not change with zoom
title: Map scale
description: The scale bar: a 1px ruler with ticks and the distance its whole length covers.
